**17.2 Delivery Discrepancy Report – 2025-08-04**

A discrepancy was noted on delivery of caustic soda (50%) under PO-2025-0788. The delivery note
stated 2000 kg (80 drums of 25 kg). On offloading, the gatehouse count recorded 79 drums. A
subsequent check of the stillage found that one drum had suffered a split seam and leaked its
contents onto the stillage tray. The drum was weighed; residual weight was 11 kg, indicating a loss
of 14 kg. The supplier (Birtley Chemicals Ltd) was notified by phone on the same day; a written
notification was sent by email on 2025-08-05. Birtley Chemicals raised a credit note (CN-4521) for
the full drum weight of 25 kg, which was received on 2025-08-11. The spill was contained within
the bunded delivery area; no environmental impact. Clean-up was carried out by the site
maintenance team; absorbent granules used were disposed of as hazardous waste (see waste log,
entry 2025-08-04).
